name: rdp-session-preservation
displayName: rdp-session-preservation — never disrupt the current remote/graphical session without signalling, risk analysis and the user's decision
description: MANDATORY before any change touching RDP / remote desktop or the graphical session it shows. Inventory the live session, classify each command (none / reconnect / session-ending), signal with a risk analysis before executing, wait for the user's explicit decision, and read back afterwards.
author: Marcus Vinícius de Lima (holding)

usage.aiAssistants: Before ANY RDP/remote-desktop/display/session change: inventory, classify, signal + risk analysis, wait for the user's go, read back.
usage.engineers: Process skill that keeps live remote sessions from being killed by maintenance.
usage.founders: No agent ends or disrupts your current session without telling you the risk first; the decision is yours.
